items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Ella Fitzgerald came in and recorded with the Basie band so they added a trombone on that.

ctx.x: Did you ever have an occasion to play with Basie in any context?

Well, in the recording studios. He would come to New York to make records and he normally only carried three trombones with him so they’d add me on to the band to fill out the section, and I ended up getting a few solos down on the record with Basie. I think it was about four albums, and then Ella Fitzgerald came in and recorded with the Basie band so they added a trombone on that. And Sammy Davis Jr. Like the recording studios got me into a lot of different situations you know, a lot of people would come through…

I wanted to ask you about your work with the Basie band. Can you tell us about the sound or the feel of that rhythm section? Because everybody says they like that rhythm section, that was the rhythm section, the big band rhythm section.
